quarterly_data.quarter: AMD blog: Available for Order: Flight-Qualified AMD Versal Adaptive (03-17-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: AMD: the Versal AI Edge XQR Series XQRVE2302 achieved Class B qualification (derived from MIL-PRF-38535) as the second radiation-tolerant space-grade XQR Versal device qualified for spaceflight; customers can begin placing orders, with shipments expected to begin in the fall; its AIE-ML engines offer 2X the INT8 and 16X the BFLOAT16 performance of first-generation AI Engines in a 23mm x 23mm package.
